scripts.openapi:bundle: mkdir -p openapi/dist && redocly bundle openapi/qred-api.yaml --output openapi/dist/openapi.bundle.yaml
scripts.mock: npm run openapi:bundle && prism mock openapi/dist/openapi.bundle.yaml --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4010
scripts.mock:dynamic: npm run openapi:bundle && prism mock openapi/dist/openapi.bundle.yaml --dynamic --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4010
scripts.docs:swagger: npm run openapi:bundle && npx swagger-ui-watcher openapi/dist/openapi.bundle.yaml --port 8080
